name: Chicken Samosa
description: Embark on a flavourful journey with our Chicken Samosa. These golden parcels of delight are filled with succulent chicken, aromatic spices, and a hint of warmth. Each bite offers a perfect balance of crispy exterior and savoury filling, making it a beloved snack that leaves a lasting impression

name: Fried Jumbo Shrimp
description: Dive into a sea of flavour with our Fried Jumbo Shrimp. Indulge in six succulent pieces of plump shrimp, lightly breaded and fried to a perfect golden crisp. With each bite, experience the ocean's bounty and a satisfying crunch that captures the essence of seafood indulgence. (6 pieces)

name: Hot Chicken Wings
description: Turn up the heat with our Hot Chicken Wings. A tantalizing serving of six tender and juicy chicken wings, coated in a fiery blend of spices that pack a flavourful punch. Whether you're a spice enthusiast or simply seeking a bold culinary adventure, these wings are sure to ignite your taste buds.

name: BBQ Wings
description: Experience BBQ bliss with our delectable BBQ Wings. Sink your teeth into six succulent chicken wings, meticulously glazed with our signature smoky barbecue sauce. The perfect harmony of sweet and savoury flavours, these wings promise a mouth-watering journey that captures the essence of classic barbecue goodness.

name: Pepper Chicken Wings
description: Elevate your wing game with our Pepper Chicken Wings. Delight in six perfectly seasoned chicken wings, coated in a zesty pepper-infused marinade that brings a kick of flavor to every bite. A bold and flavourful choice that's sure to excite your taste buds

name: Fried Shrimp Basket
description: Indulge in oceanic delight with our Fried Shrimp Basket. A generous portion of plump and crispy fried shrimp, served alongside a medley of dipping sauces. A true seafood lover's dream, offering a satisfying crunch and succulent flavors that transport you straight to the coast.

name: Chicken and Chips
description: Satisfy your cravings with our classic Chicken and Chips. Enjoy a succulent piece of perfectly fried chicken, paired with a generous helping of golden, crispy fries. A timeless combination that delivers comfort and flavour in every mouth-watering bite.

name: Only Chips
description: Experience the simple pleasure of our Crispy Chips. A generous portion of golden fries, expertly cooked to a perfect crunch. Whether enjoyed as a satisfying snack or a delightful side, these chips are sure to add a touch of crispy goodness to your dining experience.

name: Chicken Spring Rolls
description: Indulge in the perfect appetizer with our Chicken Spring Roll. Crispy, golden rolls filled with tender chicken and a medley of fresh vegetables, expertly crafted to deliver a delightful crunch with every bite. Each portion comes with six delectable pieces, making it an ideal choice for sharing or enjoying all to yourself

name: Vegetable Spring Rolls
description: Discover a garden-fresh delight with our Vegetable Spring Roll. Six pieces of crispy perfection, filled with an assortment of colourful garden vegetables, expertly rolled to create a satisfying crunch with every bite. A light and flavourful appetizer that celebrates the beauty of nature on your plate.

name: Shrimp Spring Roll
description: Savour the delicate flavours of our Shrimp Spring Roll. A culinary delight wrapped in a thin, translucent rice paper, it features succulent shrimp, fresh herbs, and crisp vegetables. The combination of textures and the subtle blend of flavours make this appetizer a perfect choice for those who appreciate a light and refreshing start to their meal.

name: Butterfly King Prawn
description: A sumptuous feast for the senses, our Butterfly King Prawns are carefully selected for their size and succulence. These premium prawns are delicately sliced open, resembling beautiful butterflies, and marinated in a blend of fragrant herbs and spices. They are then lightly battered and fried to golden perfection, ensuring a crisp exterior that gives way to tender, juicy flesh. Served with a side of our special dipping sauce, crafted from a secret recipe, this dish offers a harmonious balance of flavors and textures that will tantalize your taste buds and leave you craving for more. Perfect for a luxurious starter or a mouthwatering main, our Butterfly King Prawns are a true testament to the art of Chinese cooking.

name: Dumplings
description: Dive into the heart of Chinese culinary tradition with our handcrafted Dumplings, a staple that embodies the essence of comfort food with a gourmet twist. Each dumpling is meticulously prepared, wrapping a thin, tender dough around a hearty filling of your choice – succulent pork, juicy chicken, fresh vegetables, or a combination thereof, all seasoned to perfection with a blend of traditional spices and aromatics. These little parcels of joy are then steamed to soft, pillowy perfection or pan-fried to achieve a delightful contrast of textures: a crispy bottom and a tender top. Served with a side of our signature soy-based dipping sauce, infused with ginger, garlic, and a hint of sesame oil, our Dumplings promise a burst of flavors with every bite. Ideal for sharing or savoring solo, they offer a comforting embrace of warmth and satisfaction.

name: Prawns on Toast
description: Our Prawns on Toast is a classic Chinese delicacy that showcases the delicate sweetness of prawns combined with the savory crunch of toast. We start with the finest, succulent prawns, which are carefully minced and mixed with a blend of aromatic herbs and seasonings. This mixture is then generously spread over slices of fresh bread, ensuring each piece is packed with flavor.

name: Barbecue Spare Ribs
description: Barbecue Spare Ribs are a mouthwatering and indulgent dish that brings the smoky, savory flavors of Chinese barbecue to your table. This dish features tender pork ribs that are slow-cooked to perfection, allowing the meat to become incredibly soft and juicy, before being coated in a rich, flavorful barbecue sauce that has just the right balance of sweetness and tanginess.

name: De-Geogold Crispy Beef
description: Our Geogold Crispy Beef starts with high-quality beef, carefully sliced into thin strips for maximum tenderness. The beef is marinated in a special blend of soy sauce, ginger, garlic, and a touch of rice wine, allowing the flavors to penetrate deeply and enhance the natural richness of the meat. After marinating, the beef is coated in a light, golden batter that crisps up beautifully when fried.

name: Salt Pepper Fried Calamari
description: Our Salt Pepper Fried Calamari begins with the freshest calamari, expertly cleaned and cut into bite-sized rings. The calamari is then lightly marinated in a mixture of garlic, ginger, and a hint of rice wine to enhance its natural flavor and tenderness.

name: Fried Crab with Rock Salt
description: Our Fried Crab with Rock Salt begins with the finest, freshest crabs, carefully selected for their plumpness and flavor. The crabs are cleaned and prepared, with each piece being lightly coated in a delicate batter. This batter is designed to create a thin, crispy layer that seals in the moisture of the crab while adding a satisfying crunch.

name: Deep Fried Butterfly King Prawn
description: Our Deep Fried Butterfly King Prawn features two large, premium king prawns, known for their sweet, juicy meat and impressive size. Each prawn is carefully butterflied, a technique where the prawn is split open along the back, creating a beautiful, flat shape that resembles a butterfly when cooked. This method not only enhances the prawn's presentation but also allows it to cook evenly, ensuring that every bite is tender and flavorful. (2 pieces)

name: Fried Lobster with Rock Salt
description: Our Fried Lobster with Rock Salt features succulent lobster, chosen for its tender meat and rich flavor. The lobster is carefully prepared, with each piece cut into manageable portions while ensuring that the delicate meat remains intact. The lobster is then lightly coated in a thin layer of flour or cornstarch, which helps to create a crisp, golden crust when fried.

name: Singapore Noodles
description: Embark on a culinary journey with our Singapore Noodles. A vibrant stir-fry of thin rice vermicelli noodles, tender pieces of meat or shrimp, and an array of colourful vegetables. Infused with aromatic spices and sauces, this dish offers a harmonious blend of textures and flavours that captures the essence of Southeast Asian cuisine.

name: Vegetable Noodles
description: Experience the freshness of our Vegetable Noodles. Delicate egg or rice noodles are expertly stir-fried with a colourful medley of garden-fresh vegetables. This dish is a celebration of wholesome flavours, offering a satisfying harmony of textures and tastes that's both nourishing and delightful."

name: Singapore Noodles Mixed of Seafood
description: Dive into a symphony of flavours from the sea with our Seafood Singapore Noodles. A tantalizing stir-fry of thin rice vermicelli noodles, brimming with an assortment of succulent seafood. The dish is enriched with aromatic spices and sauces, offering a medley of textures and oceanic flavours that transport you to the shores of Southeast Asia.

name: Spaghetti Bolognese
description: Indulge in a classic favourite with our Spaghetti Bolognese. Al dente spaghetti pasta is generously coated with a rich and hearty Bolognese sauce, lovingly prepared with a blend of seasoned ground meat and savoury tomatoes. This dish offers a timeless taste of Italian comfort that's both satisfying and nostalgic.

name: Chinese Noodles Chicken
description: Our Chinese Noodles with Chicken features thin, springy noodles stir-fried to perfection, absorbing all the rich flavors of the sauce and other ingredients. The chicken, typically sliced thin and marinated in a mixture of soy sauce, garlic, and a touch of sesame oil, is cooked until tender and juicy. This marination ensures the chicken is full of flavor and remains moist throughout the cooking process.

description: Experience the culinary masterpiece that is our Geogold Special Chicken. Tender chicken is expertly prepared and served in a sauce crafted to perfection. name: Diced Chicken in Chili Sauce
description: Our Diced Chicken in Chili Sauce features succulent pieces of chicken breast or thigh, cut into bite-sized cubes for easy eating. The chicken is marinated briefly to enhance its natural flavor, typically with a mix of soy sauce, rice wine, and a touch of cornstarch to help lock in the moisture and create a tender, juicy texture.

description: Our Diced Chicken in Ginger & Oyster Sauce features juicy, bite-sized pieces of chicken breast or thigh, marinated to enhance their natural flavor and tenderness. The chicken is stir-fried to perfection, ensuring that each piece is cooked through yet remains moist and succulent.

name: Shredded Chicken with Green-Pepper
description: Our Shredded Chicken with Green Pepper features thin strips of chicken breast or thigh, carefully shredded to ensure a tender and even texture. The chicken is marinated in a subtle blend of soy sauce, ginger, and garlic, which enhances its natural flavor without overpowering it. This marination process also helps to keep the chicken moist and tender during cooking.

name: Diced Chicken in Coconut Sauce
description: Our Diced Chicken in Coconut Sauce features tender, bite-sized pieces of chicken breast or thigh, cooked to perfection to ensure juiciness and flavor. The chicken is first marinated in a light mixture of soy sauce, ginger, and garlic, which enhances its taste and adds a subtle depth of flavor.

name: Kung Pao Chicken
description: Our Kung Pao Chicken features succulent pieces of chicken breast or thigh, diced into bite-sized portions for easy eating. The chicken is marinated in a mixture of soy sauce, rice wine, and cornstarch, which ensures it stays tender and juicy during cooking.

name: Dried Chicken with Chlli and Garlic Sauce
description: Our Dried Chicken with Chili and Garlic Sauce features small, dried pieces of chicken that are cooked until they develop a slightly crispy texture on the outside while remaining tender and flavorful on the inside. The chicken is marinated in a mixture of soy sauce, rice wine, and a touch of cornstarch, which helps to lock in moisture and enhance its natural taste.

name: Seafood and Vegetable Soup
description: Dive into a bowl of our Seafood and Vegetable Soup. A medley of ocean's finest treasures and vibrant garden vegetables come together in a comforting broth. Each spoonful is a journey of flavours, offering the freshness of the sea and the wholesome goodness of vegetables in every bite.

name: Seafood Soup
description: Experience the bounty of the sea with our exquisite Seafood Soup. A rich and flavourful broth teeming with an array of succulent seafood treasures. From tender shrimp to delicate pieces of fish, every spoonful captures the essence of the ocean's finest offerings, delivering a taste of maritime indulgence.

name: Sweet Corn Soup
description: Embrace warmth and comfort with our Sweet Corn Soup. A velvety blend of sweet corn kernels, gentle spices, and a delicate creaminess that soothes the soul. This classic favorite is a testament to the beauty of simplicity, offering a heartwarming and satisfying bowl of goodness

name: Pecking Soup
description: Embark on a culinary journey with our Pecking Soup. A fragrant broth infused with a harmonious blend of aromatic herbs and tender pieces of poultry. This traditional delight captures the essence of time-honoured flavours, inviting you to savor a comforting and nourishing experience.

name: Cream Seafood Delight Soup
description: Indulge in the luxurious flavours of our Creamy Seafood Delight Soup. A velvety concoction that marries the richness of cream with an array of delectable seafood treasures. Each spoonful offers a harmonious blend of textures and tastes, making it a truly decadent choice for those seeking a taste of elegance.

name: Spicy Crab Meat Soup
description: Delight in the ocean's finest with our Crab Meat Soup. A luscious blend of tender crab meat, aromatic spices, and a savoury broth that captures the essence of the sea. Each spoonful is a celebration of flavours, offering a taste of indulgence and the pure delight of premium crab.

name: Chicken Cream Soup
description: Experience comfort in a bowl with our Chicken Cream Soup. A velvety blend of tender chicken, delicate herbs, and the luxurious creaminess that warms both heart and soul. This timeless classic offers a soothing escape and a taste of pure cosiness with every spoonful.

name: Vegetable Soup
description: Vegetable Soup: Our Vegetable Soup is a vibrant medley of freshness, carefully simmered to nourish the soul and delight the palate. This light yet flavorful broth is a testament to the richness of nature, brimming with a colorful array of seasonal vegetables, each selected for their crispness and depth of flavor. We blend tender carrots, succulent zucchini, sweet peas, and leafy greens, among other garden treasures, to create a harmony of tastes and textures. Infused with a delicate mix of herbs and a hint of garlic, the soup is gently simmered to draw out the vegetables' inherent sweetness and complexity. This wholesome bowl is not only a feast for the eyes but also a restorative elixir, perfect for starting your meal on a refreshing note or enjoying as a light, standalone dish. Our Vegetable Soup invites you to savor the simplicity and elegance of expertly prepared, garden-fresh produce.

name: Wonton Soup (Chicken)
description: Our Wonton Soup (Chicken) begins with handmade chicken wontons, which are carefully crafted using a blend of ground chicken, finely chopped vegetables, and a touch of garlic and ginger for extra flavor. The chicken filling is wrapped in thin, delicate wonton wrappers, which are folded into their signature shape, creating little parcels of deliciousness.

name: Chicken with Corn Soup
description: Our Chicken with Corn Soup is made with succulent pieces of chicken breast or thigh, which are gently poached to retain their tenderness and juiciness. The chicken is finely shredded and added to a rich, savory broth that serves as the base of the soup.

name: De Geogold Seafood
description: Our De Geogold Seafood Soup is crafted with a selection of premium seafood, including succulent shrimp, tender scallops, delicate fish fillets, and sweet crab meat. Each piece of seafood is chosen for its freshness and flavor, ensuring that every bite is a taste of the sea.

name: Roasted Pork and Chinese Vegetable
description: Savour the fusion of flavours with our Roasted Pork and Chinese Vegetable dish. Succulent pieces of perfectly roasted pork are paired with a colourful medley of crisp, stir-fried vegetables, all harmonized by a savoury Asian-inspired sauce. A culinary delight that brings together the richness of pork and the freshness of vegetables in every delicious bite.

name: Roasted Pork with Mixed Vegetable
description: Indulge in a symphony of flavours with our Roasted Pork and Mixed Vegetable ensemble. Tender slices of succulent roasted pork, expertly paired with a vibrant medley of garden-fresh vegetables. This dish offers a delightful balance of hearty and wholesome, showcasing the artistry of culinary craftsmanship in every forkful.

name: Roasted Pork with Broccoli
description: Experience a delightful pairing with our Roasted Pork and Broccoli. Tender, flavourful slices of roasted pork are elegantly complemented by vibrant, lightly steamed broccoli florets. This dish harmonizes the richness of pork with the freshness of broccoli, delivering a satisfying and balanced culinary experience.

name: Pork with Mushrooms
description: Delight in a savoury medley with our Pork with Mushrooms. Succulent pieces of pork are sautéed to perfection and paired with a delectable assortment of mushrooms. A harmonious blend of textures and earthy flavors that creates a truly satisfying dish, offering a taste of culinary sophistication. Delight in a savoury medley with our Pork with Mushrooms. Succulent pieces of pork are sautéed to perfection and paired with a delectable assortment of mushrooms. A harmonious blend of textures and earthy flavours that creates a truly satisfying dish, offering a taste of culinary sophistication.

name: Pork and Cashew Nuts
description: Experience a perfect balance of flavours with our Pork and Cashew Nuts. Tender slices of pork stir-fried with a generous helping of crunchy cashew nuts, creating a delightful contrast of textures. The savoury-sweet sauce binds it all together, offering a mouth-watering dish that's both satisfying and indulgent.

name: Sweet & Pork
description: Our Sweet & Sour Pork features succulent pieces of pork that are marinated, lightly battered, and then fried to achieve a crispy, golden-brown exterior while keeping the meat tender and juicy inside. The pork is the star of this dish, providing a hearty and satisfying bite with every mouthful.

name: Shredded Pork in Spicy Sauce
description: Our Shredded Pork in Spicy Sauce features tender pork, thinly sliced into fine strips to ensure each piece is flavorful and easy to eat. The pork is marinated in a mixture of soy sauce, garlic, and a hint of ginger, which infuses the meat with savory undertones and keeps it juicy during cooking.

name: Pork in Chili Sauce
description: Our Pork in Chili Sauce features succulent pieces of pork that are carefully sliced or diced to ensure tenderness and an even distribution of flavors. The pork is marinated in a blend of soy sauce, garlic, and ginger, which enhances its natural flavors and helps to keep the meat juicy during cooking.

name: Pork Spareribs with Veggies
description: Our Pork Spareribs with Veggies features succulent pork spareribs that are slow-cooked or braised to achieve a tender, fall-off-the-bone texture. The ribs are marinated in a blend of soy sauce, garlic, and spices, allowing the flavors to deeply penetrate the meat, resulting in a savory and robust taste.

name: Sliced Lamb in Curry Sauce
description: Our Sliced Lamb in Curry Sauce features tender lamb, thinly sliced to ensure each piece is soft and flavorful. The lamb is marinated in a blend of spices, including garlic, ginger, and a touch of soy sauce, which enhances its natural flavors and keeps the meat juicy during cooking.

name: Sliced Lamb with Vegetables
description: Our Sliced Lamb with Vegetables features premium lamb, thinly sliced to ensure tenderness and even cooking. The lamb is marinated in a blend of soy sauce, garlic, ginger, and a touch of sesame oil, which enhances its natural flavors and keeps the meat juicy and flavorful.

name: Geogold Special Sauce
description: Elevate your dining experience with our signature Geogold Special Sauce. With a perfect balance of savoury, tangy, and a touch of sweetness, this sauce adds a touch of culinary magic to any selection.

name: Beef and Curry Sauce
description: Indulge in a journey of taste with our Beef and Curry Sauce. Tender beef slices are luxuriously coated in a fragrant and rich curry sauce, infusing every bite with a symphony of exotic spices and hearty flavors. A harmonious fusion that captures the essence of global cuisine in a single, unforgettable dish.

name: Beef and Garlic Sauce
description: Experience the enticing aroma of our Beef and Garlic Sauce. Succulent beef slices are wok-tossed to perfection and bathed in a savoury garlic-infused sauce. The marriage of tender meat and the bold, aromatic essence of garlic creates a dish that's both comforting and full of flavour.

name: Hot and Spicy Beef Sauce
description: Ignite your taste buds with our Hot and Spicy Beef Sauce. Tender beef slices are enrobed in a fiery blend of spices, creating a dish that's as bold as it is flavorful. Each bite is a thrilling adventure, a dance of heat and flavor that leaves a tantalizing impression.

name: Huanan Beef Suace
description: Embark on a culinary journey with our Huanan Beef Sauce. Experience the rich cultural heritage of the Huanan region in every mouth-watering bite.

name: Beef with Black Been Sauce
description: Delight in a bold and savory adventure with our Beef with Black Bean Sauce. Succulent beef slices are stir-fried to perfection and combined with the robust flavours of black bean sauce. This dish offers a tantalizing blend of umami and richness that's as satisfying as it is memorable.

name: Beef with String Beef Sauce
description: Delight in a bold and savoury adventure with our Beef with Black Bean Sauce. Succulent beef slices are stir-fried to perfection and combined with the robust flavours of black bean sauce. name: Shreeded Beef with Green Pepper & Onions
description: Shredded Beef with Green Pepper & Onions: Embark on a flavorful journey with our Shredded Beef with Green Pepper & Onions, a dish that masterfully combines tender, marinated beef with the crisp freshness of green bell peppers and the sweet sharpness of onions. The beef, carefully selected for its quality and texture, is slow-cooked until perfectly tender, then expertly shredded to absorb the rich blend of savory sauces and aromatic spices. Stir-fried with slices of green pepper and onion, this dish achieves a delightful balance of flavors and textures, where the sweetness of the vegetables complements the savory depth of the beef. A hint of spice and the smokiness from the wok lend an irresistible aroma and a bold character to this classic dish. Served steaming hot, our Shredded Beef with Green Pepper & Onions is a testament to the art of Chinese cooking, promising a memorable experience with every bite. Perfect for those who appreciate a dish that combines robust flavors with the freshness of vegetables, it's an ideal choice for a satisfying main course.

This marination not only enhances the beef's flavor but also helps to create a silky, tender texture that pairs beautifully with the broccoli.

description: Our Sliced Beef in Black Pepper Sauce features premium cuts of beef, such as flank steak or ribeye, thinly sliced to ensure tenderness and even cooking. The beef is marinated in a light mixture of soy sauce, garlic, and a touch of cornstarch, which not only enhances its flavor but also ensures a silky texture.

name: Beef with Dried Chlli and Garlic Sauce
description: Our Beef with Dried Chili and Garlic Sauce features tender slices of beef, expertly cut to ensure a perfect balance between tenderness and flavor absorption. description: Dive into a symphony of flavours with our Shrimp and Mixed Vegetable medley. A celebration of freshness and taste that captures the essence of culinary craftsmanship.

name: Shrimps and Broccoli

name: Fried Shrimp Balls with Spicy
description: Embrace bold flavours with our Fried Shrimp Balls with Spicy Sauce. These delectable morsels feature plump shrimp rolled into crispy, golden balls and served with a tantalizing spicy sauce. Each bite is a fusion of textures and spices, making it a memorable choice for those seeking an exciting and flavourful culinary experience.

name: Shrimp with Black Been Sauce
description: Delight in a symphony of tastes with our Shrimp with Black Bean Sauce. Plump and succulent shrimp are stir-fried to perfection and paired with the rich and savoury flavours of black bean sauce. This dish offers a harmonious blend of textures and umami, creating a satisfying and memorable culinary journey

name: Shrimp and Cashew Nut
description: Experience a perfect pairing with our Shrimp and Cashew Nut dish. Plump and succulent shrimp are expertly stir-fried alongside crunchy cashew nuts, creating a delightful interplay of textures. The sauce binds these elements together, offering a savoury-sweet harmony that's sure to please your palate.

name: Hot Spicy Shrimp Sauce
description: Turn up the heat with our Hot Spicy Shrimp Sauce. Plump and succulent shrimp are infused with a fiery blend of spices, creating a dish that's not only delicious but also exhilarating. Each bite is a thrilling explosion of flavour, making this dish a favourite among spice enthusiasts.

name: Fried Shrimp Balls Sweet and Sour
description: indulge in a delightful blend of flavours with our Fried Shrimp Balls Sweet and Sour. Plump shrimp are transformed into crispy, golden balls and served with a tangy sweet and sour sauce. This dish offers a perfect harmony of textures and tastes, combining the crunch of the shrimp balls with the vibrant zing of the sauce.

name: Sizziling Prawns
description: Experience sizzling excitement with our Sizzling Prawns. Succulent prawns are cooked to perfection and presented on a sizzling platter, releasing an enticing aroma. The dish is a captivating sensory experience, offering both visual allure and a delectable taste of the sea.

name: Lobster with Black Bean Sauce
description: Lobster with Black Bean Sauce: Indulge in the luxurious taste of our Lobster with Black Bean Sauce, a dish that showcases the opulence of the sea married with the depth of traditional Chinese flavors. This exquisite creation features succulent lobster meat, carefully extracted from its shell and stir-fried with aromatic garlic, ginger, and scallions. The star of the dish, our savory black bean sauce, is a rich blend of fermented black beans, soy sauce, and a hint of Shaoxing wine, offering a complex flavor profile that perfectly complements the sweetness of the lobster. Each bite promises a symphony of textures and tastes, enhanced by the slight heat from fresh chili peppers and the earthy tones of the black bean sauce. Presented with elegance, this dish not only pleases the palate but also captivates the senses with its vibrant colors and enticing aroma. Ideal for a special occasion or a lavish feast, our Lobster with Black Bean Sauce is a testament to the art of fine Chinese cuisine, promising an unforgettable dining experience.

name: Lobster with Mushroom Sauce
description: Lobster with Mushroom Sauce: Experience the epitome of culinary elegance with our Lobster with Mushroom Sauce, a dish that harmoniously blends the ocean's bounty with the earthy richness of mushrooms. This gourmet offering features tender, succulent lobster tails, expertly prepared to preserve their natural juiciness and flavor. The lobster is then lavishly coated in a creamy mushroom sauce, crafted from a selection of the finest mushrooms, simmered in a rich broth with a touch of cream to achieve a velvety texture that complements the lobster's delicate taste. Enhanced with a whisper of garlic, a splash of white wine, and a hint of fresh herbs, this sauce elevates the dish to new heights of flavor complexity. Presented with a side of lightly sautéed greens, this dish is not only a feast for the taste buds but also a visual masterpiece that promises to enchant and delight. Perfect for those seeking a sophisticated dining experience, our Lobster with Mushroom Sauce is a testament to the refined simplicity of combining land and sea, offering an exquisite blend of textures and flavors that will leave you longing for more.

name: Lobster with Mixed Vegetables
description:
Lobster with Mixed Vegetables: Revel in the vibrant and wholesome delicacy of our Lobster with Mixed Vegetables, a dish that epitomizes the fusion of sea's treasures with the bounty of the garden. This masterpiece starts with plump, juicy lobster tails, steamed or lightly grilled to perfection, preserving their natural sweetness and succulent texture. These heavenly pieces are then tossed together with a colorful medley of crisp, seasonal vegetables - including bell peppers, broccoli, snap peas, and carrots - all stir-fried to maintain their crunch and vivid hues.

The ensemble is lightly glazed with a delicate sauce that enhances but never overshadows the natural flavors of the ingredients. This sauce, a subtle blend of soy sauce, oyster sauce, and a hint of sesame oil, adds depth and a silky finish to the dish. Finished with a sprinkle of fresh scallions and cilantro for an added layer of freshness, our Lobster with Mixed Vegetables is a celebration of textures and flavors, offering a healthy, balanced, and utterly satisfying dining experience.

Perfect for those who appreciate the nuanced flavors of seafood combined with the crisp freshness of garden vegetables, this dish is a testament to the art of balancing diverse ingredients to create a harmonious and nutritious meal.

name: Lobster with Garlic Sauce in a Hot Plate
description:
Lobster with Garlic Sauce in a Hot Plate: Immerse yourself in the aromatic allure of our Lobster with Garlic Sauce, served sizzling on a hot plate for an unforgettable dining spectacle. This dish features the king of the sea, the lobster, prepared with meticulous care to highlight its natural sweetness and tender texture. The lobster is sautéed with an abundance of finely minced garlic, creating a rich and fragrant base that permeates the succulent meat with its pungent, tantalizing aroma.

The garlic sauce, a masterful blend of soy sauce, a touch of sugar, and a hint of white pepper, is thickened to perfection, enveloping the lobster in a glossy, flavorful embrace. A splash of Shaoxing wine adds a layer of complexity and depth, enhancing the garlic's robust character without overpowering the lobster's delicate flavor.

Served on a hot plate, this dish arrives at your table bubbling and aromatic, promising a sensory experience that engages sight, smell, and taste. The heat from the plate continues to gently cook the sauce, ensuring every bite is infused with the warm, garlicky essence. Ideal for garlic lovers and those seeking a bold flavor profile, our Lobster with Garlic Sauce in a Hot Plate is a celebration of rich, comforting flavors, perfectly balanced to showcase the luxuriousness of lobster.

name: Calemari with Curry Sauce
description: Calamari with Curry Sauce: Tender calamari rings lightly battered and fried until golden, served with a rich, aromatic curry sauce that blends spices and coconut milk for a creamy, spicy kick. Perfect for those who love a touch of exotic flavor.

name: Calemari with Curry Sauce
description: Calamari with Garlic Sauce: Crispy fried calamari tossed in a savory garlic sauce, made with minced garlic, olive oil, and a hint of chili for a deliciously bold flavor. Ideal for garlic lovers seeking a crunchy, flavorful treat.

name: Calemari with Black Bean Sauce
description: Calamari with Black Bean Sauce: Tender calamari stir-fried with a savory black bean sauce, featuring fermented black beans, garlic, and a hint of ginger for a bold, flavorful experience. A perfect choice for enthusiasts of rich, umami flavors.

name: Shreded Calimari with Green Pepper
description: Our Shredded Calamari with Green Pepper features fresh calamari, carefully cleaned and cut into thin, tender strips. The calamari is lightly seasoned with a touch of salt, pepper, and a hint of garlic before being quickly stir-fried to preserve its delicate texture and natural sweetness.

name: Calamari in Chili Sauce
description: Our Calamari in Chili Sauce features fresh calamari, cut into rings or strips, and cooked to perfection. The calamari is lightly seasoned with salt and pepper, then quickly stir-fried to maintain its tender texture and natural sweetness.

description: Our Fried Lobster in Chili Sauce features fresh lobster, carefully prepared to ensure each piece is juicy and tender. The lobster is lightly battered and quickly fried to create a slightly crispy exterior that locks in the lobster’s natural sweetness and delicate texture.

name: Coconut Rice
description:
Coconut Bliss Rice Bowl:
Indulge in a tropical escape with our Coconut Bliss Rice Bowl. Fragrant jasmine rice delicately cooked in creamy coconut milk, infused with the essence of exotic spices. Topped with a medley of fresh vegetables and your choice of succulent protein, this dish promises a symphony of flavors that will transport your taste buds to paradise. Immerse yourself in the rich, velvety texture of coconut-infused rice, a culinary journey that captures the essence of the tropics in every satisfying bite.

name: Oriental Rice and Mixed Meat
description: Embark on a culinary journey with our Oriental Rice and Mixed Meat Fusion. Experience the perfect marriage of traditional Asian flavors and contemporary twists. Fragrant jasmine rice serves as the canvas for a tantalizing array of mixed meats, expertly wok-tossed to perfection. Savory slices of beef, succulent chicken, and tender shrimp mingle harmoniously with crisp vegetables in a symphony of taste and texture. The medley is elevated with our signature oriental sauce, creating a dish that transcends borders, bringing together the best of both worlds on your plate. Prepare to savor a delightful union of diverse culinary influences in every delightful bite.

name: Basmatic Rice with Maryland Sauce
description: Dive into a seafood lover's paradise with our Basmati Rice paired with Maryland Sauce. Immerse your senses in the rich, briny essence of the Chesapeake Bay as plump shrimp, sweet crab, and tender scallops mingle with aromatic Basmati rice. The Maryland Sauce, a harmonious blend of Old Bay seasoning, butter, and a hint of lemon, envelops the dish in a coastal symphony of flavors. Each spoonful promises a delightful journey to the shores of Maryland, where the freshest ingredients meet the warmth of southern hospitality. Succulent, savory, and simply unforgettable – this dish is a celebration of the sea in every mouthwatering bite.

name: Kidney Souce Served with Boild Yam and Plantain
description:
**Savory Kidney Medley with Boiled Yam and Plantain:**
Embark on a journey of rich, robust flavors with our Kidney Source served alongside perfectly boiled yam and sweet plantains. Our chefs artfully combine tender kidney cuts with a savory medley of spices, creating a dish that is both hearty and satisfying. The velvety texture of the kidney is complemented by the softness of boiled yam and the sweetness of plantains. Each bite is a celebration of traditional flavors, offering a symphony of tastes that pay homage to culinary heritage. A comforting and wholesome dish, this combination promises a unique and delicious experience for your taste buds.

name: Green Spinach with Boiled Yam or Plantain
description:
**Palak Harmony - Green Spinach Delight with Boiled Yam or Plantain:**
Immerse yourself in the vibrant world of flavors with our Palak Harmony, a delightful fusion of green spinach paired with your choice of boiled yam or plantain. Fresh spinach leaves, sautéed to perfection with aromatic spices and herbs, create a verdant symphony on your plate. The velvety texture of the spinach melds seamlessly with the hearty goodness of boiled yam or the sweet notes of plantain, offering a perfect balance of flavors and textures. This dish is not just a celebration of greens but a culinary ode to simplicity and wholesomeness. Dive into a world of freshness and nourishment with every wholesome bite.

name: Poached or Omelet Egg with Chips
description: Elevate your breakfast experience with our Poached or Omelet Egg served alongside crispy golden chips. Immerse yourself in the luscious allure of a perfectly poached egg or the delightful fluffiness of an expertly crafted omelet. Nestled alongside these culinary masterpieces are golden-brown chips, adding a satisfying crunch to each bite. The contrast of velvety egg and crisp chips creates a harmonious symphony of textures, while the rich, runny yolk or savory omelet unfolds a burst of flavors. A breakfast treat that transcends the ordinary, this dish is a testament to the artistry of simplicity and the joy of classic morning indulgence.

name: Scotced Egg with Oath
description:
Highland Scotch Egg with Oat Crust:
Experience the epitome of culinary craftsmanship with our Highland Scotch Egg accompanied by a hearty oat crust. Immerse yourself in the rich flavors of a perfectly soft-boiled egg encased in a golden layer of seasoned sausage meat. This classic dish takes a Scottish twist with a crunchy oat crust, adding a delightful nuttiness to each bite. The marriage of textures, from the succulent sausage to the creamy egg and the rustic oat coating, creates a symphony of flavors that pays homage to traditional Scottish fare. Elevate your dining experience with this indulgent treat, a perfect blend of heritage and innovation on every plate.

name: Meat Ball Sauce & Couscous or Pasta
description: Savor the taste of the Mediterranean with our tantalizing Meatball Sauce paired with your choice of fluffy couscous or al dente pasta. Succulent meatballs, crafted with a blend of premium meats and aromatic spices, are bathed in a rich, savory sauce that captures the essence of Mediterranean cuisine. The dish offers a harmonious marriage of textures and flavors, as the tender meatballs are perfectly complemented by the light and fluffy couscous or the comforting embrace of pasta. Every forkful is a journey through the sun-kissed flavors of the Mediterranean, promising a dining experience that is both satisfying and soul-soothing.

name: Jollof Rice Served with Special Sauce and Boiled Egg
description: Indulge in a celebration of West African flavors with our Jollof Rice, served alongside a tantalizing Special Sauce and a perfectly boiled egg. Our Jollof Rice is a symphony of fragrant basmati rice, slow-cooked in a tomato and pepper-infused blend of spices that embody the heart of West African cuisine. The Special Sauce, a secret blend of herbs and aromatics, elevates the dish to new heights of culinary delight. A perfectly boiled egg crowns this creation, offering a creamy addition to the medley. Immerse yourself in the rich tapestry of flavors, textures, and colors that define this quintessential West African dish, creating an experience that's both comforting and exhilarating.

name: Ofada Served with Special Sauce and Boiled Egg
description: Experience the rich tapestry of Nigerian cuisine with our Ofada rice, served alongside a tantalizing Special Sauce and a perfectly boiled egg. Each grain of Ofada rice tells a story of tradition, carefully cooked to perfection and infused with the authentic flavors of Nigeria. The Special Sauce, a closely guarded culinary secret, harmonizes with the earthy notes of the Ofada rice, creating a symphony of taste. A boiled egg adds a creamy touch, completing this flavorful trio. Dive into the heart of Nigerian culinary heritage with this dish that not only satisfies the palate but also captures the essence of tradition in every delicious bite.

name: Yam Porridge Served with Beef and Fish
description: Delight your senses with our Yam Porridge, a hearty bowl of comfort served with a delectable combination of beef and fish. Velvety yam cubes simmered to perfection in a flavorful broth create a comforting base for this dish. Succulent beef slices and tender fish add a symphony of protein-rich goodness, elevating the porridge to a surf-and-turf extravaganza. The melding of textures, from the soft yam to the hearty meats and flaky fish, promises a fulfilling and satisfying culinary experience. Immerse yourself in the warmth and heartiness of this wholesome combination, a perfect balance of flavors that celebrates the essence of home-cooked goodness.

name: Plantain Porridge Served with Beef and Fish
description: Embark on a culinary journey with our Plantain Porridge, a divine fusion of sweet plantains served alongside a delectable combination of beef and fish. Immerse yourself in the symphony of flavors as soft, ripe plantains meld with savory beef and succulent fish. The porridge is a celebration of textures, where the natural sweetness of plantains harmonizes with the richness of the beef and the delicate flavors of the fish. This dish is a testament to the artistry of combining ingredients in perfect balance, creating a truly satisfying and wholesome dining experience. Indulge in the warmth and depth of this Plantain Paradise, a delightful ode to the heartiness of home-cooked perfection.

name: Braise Fish with Seasonal Vegetables and Roasted Chilli Sauce
description: Delight in culinary artistry with our Braised Fish with Seasonal Vegetables and Roasted Chilli Sauce. The dish is elevated by a tantalizing roasted chilli sauce, creating a symphony of flavours that showcases the essence of both land and sea.

The fish is lightly seasoned with salt and pepper, then either pan-fried or steamed until just cooked, ensuring that it remains tender and juicy.

name: Fish in Szechuan Sauce

Drizzled with a dressing featuring the richness of olive oil, the tang of balsamic vinegar, and the creaminess of salad cream, this dish offers a satisfying and diverse dining experience.

name: Mix Vegetable Salad

A touch of chili sauce adds a kick of excitement, creating a delectable fusion of tastes that's perfect for a flavourful journey."
